settings.title: Settings of {world}
settings.readonly.unreadable: This world's world.json cannot be read, so its settings cannot be changed here.
settings.broken: Foreman cannot read {file} as a JSON object, so this form cannot show it. Replace the file with the JSON editor below.
settings.note.running: The server is running. Changes to these settings take effect after a restart. Changes to admins apply at once.
settings.note.running_raw: The server is running. Changes to this file take effect after a restart.
settings.name.label: Server name
settings.description.label: Description
settings.visibility.unset: The file has no visibility yet. Hidden will be written unless another is chosen.
settings.visibility.public: The file lists this server publicly, which this form does not offer. Choose an option to replace that, or choose neither to keep it.
settings.password.unset: No password is set. Anyone who can reach the server can join.
settings.password.keep: Leave blank to keep the current password.
settings.password.keep_none: Leave blank to keep no password.
settings.password.keep_pending: Your new password is kept unless you type another.
settings.password.both: Enter a new password or remove it, not both.
settings.password.dropped: Enter the new password again; it is never kept in the page.
settings.max_players.label: Maximum players
settings.verify.label: Require user verification
settings.interval.label: Autosave interval in minutes
settings.slots.label: Autosave slots
settings.auto_pause.label: Pause when no one is online
settings.admins.label: Admin names
settings.admins.broken: {file} is not a list of player names, so admins cannot be changed here. Fix the file in the world's config folder.
settings.admins.bad_name: Line {line} is not a usable player name. A name can be up to {max} bytes and cannot contain spaces, control characters or invisible characters.
settings.connected.heading: Connected now
settings.connected.hint: Players in the game right now who are not admins. Make admin adds the name to the list above and shows you the changes to check before anything is saved.
settings.error.whole: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
settings.done.saved: Settings saved. Foreman took the snapshot "{label}" first.
settings.done.restart: The server is running, so the changes to its settings take effect after a restart.
settings.error.expired: This preview has expired, or its changes were already saved. Make your changes again and preview them.
settings.error.failed: Foreman could not save the settings. Nothing was written. The details are in Foreman's log.
settings.error.partial: Foreman saved {saved}, but could not save {failed}. {reason}
settings.error.invalid: Foreman checked the new settings again and refused them, so nothing was saved. Open the JSON editor to see what is wrong.
settings.error.too_big: The settings file would be over {size}. Remove some of it.
settings.raw.title: Edit {file} of {world}
settings.raw.label: Contents of {file}
settings.raw.hint: One JSON object, up to {size}. Foreman checks the keys it knows and saves any other key as written.
settings.raw.secrets: The game password, factorio.com password and token are not shown here. They are kept unless this text gives a key a new value. An empty value removes it.
settings.raw.unreadable: Foreman cannot read {file} as JSON, so its text is not shown, in case it holds a password. Saving replaces the whole file.
settings.err.syntax: Line {line}: this is not valid JSON. Check for a missing comma, quote or bracket.
settings.err.not_object: Line {line}: the file must be one JSON object, written in braces.
settings.err.too_large: The text is over {size}. Remove some of it.
settings.err.other: Line {line}: the value of {key} is not allowed.
settings.err.missing: Line {line}: {key} is missing. The game needs it.
settings.preview.heading: Save these changes to {world}?
settings.preview.nothing: Nothing changed. The settings already hold these values.
settings.preview.nothing_left: The file changed since you previewed, and it now holds the values you chose. There is nothing left to save.
settings.preview.changed: {file} changed since you previewed. These are the changes against the file as it is now.
settings.diff.secret_added: The value is not shown. It will be set.
settings.diff.secret_changed: The value is not shown. It will be changed.
settings.diff.secret_removed: The value is not shown. It will be removed.
settings.diff.unknown: Foreman does not check this key. It is saved as written.
settings.preview.restart: The server is running. These changes take effect after a restart.
settings.preview.admins_live: The server is running. Changes to admins apply at once.
settings.preview.step_snapshot: Take an automatic snapshot of {world}. If the snapshot fails, nothing else happens.
settings.preview.step_admins_live: Promote and demote these players in the running game, which updates {file}.
settings.preview.undo: To undo, restore that snapshot from the Snapshots page.
